scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n FRONT,BACK "bun run sv:dev" "bun run hono:dev"
scripts.sv:build: bun run sv:PreBuild && bun run sv:PostBuild
scripts.hono:generate: cd packages/db && bun x drizzle-kit generate
scripts.hono:migrate: cd packages/db && bun x drizzle-kit migrate
scripts.hono:push: cd packages/db && bun x drizzle-kit push
scripts.react:build: cd apps/react && bun run build --mode production
scripts.fast:dev: cd apps/fast && uv run python -m app.dev
scripts.fast:build: cd apps/fast && uv run python -m nuitka --onefile --standalone --output-filename=serverFast app/server.py
